title: Enhanced Zeus Modules
description: Modification of the vanilla Zeus addon that adds new modules, features, bug fixes, and improves Zeus quality of life. The pinnacle of Public Zeus scripting.

title: Roles System
description: Designed to incentivize teamplay and coordination between those in groups together. Players are forced to join squads and play certain roles to access equipment making players have to rely on teammates rather than just themselves.

title: Enhancement Pack
description: Enhancement Pack is a collection of systems that improve and expand upon vanilla Arma 3 gameplay. Features include: earplugs, player dragging, suppression effects, and many, many more.
